messages:
Ashley: Quick sync — trying to finalize the event field mapping for token-cost attribution before the canary. Two asks: (A) a compact glossary of the new fields in token_event.v2 so billing/datawarehouse can map correctly, and (B) a 30–60m smoke ingest to confirm latency tags are landing. Need owners and an ETA.

Priya: I can own the glossary. Will produce a one-pager and add the minimal table to the schema docs. Planning to include field name, type, example, and owner. Target: 2pm PT update. :+1:

Jon: I can run the smoke ingest and validation script. Kicking off sample job now against staging for last 24h subset. Will post results + a short log snippet when done (~30m).

Kevin: Heads-up on the cost mapping: the downstream billing expects `billed_tokens` and `model_tier`. We'll keep `billed_tokens` = reported_tokens_for_billing (rounded up) and add `model_family` so we can map multipliers. I'll add a note to the mapping doc.

telemetry-bot: smoke-ingest job 987 started by Jon on staging (sampling last 24h events). Tracking id: sj-987.

Sam: Quick CR ping — I have PR #3124 that updates the ingestion transform to emit `decode_latency_ms` and `routing_latency_ms`. Would appreciate a quick review from @Priya or @Kevin. Small change, tests included.

Priya: Sam — i'll look in ~15. If glossary references these exact latency fields that helps. Also confirm naming convention: p50/p95 suffix vs raw_ms fields? I prefer raw fields + derived percentiles in downstream.

Kevin: Agree with Priya. Emit raw `_ms` for each stage (decode, routing, model_infer) and we'll compute p50/p95 in the analytics job.

Jon: Smoke ingest finished. Quick results: sample count 4,328 events. All required fields present in ~99.4% of samples. Missing `model_family` in ~0.6% (old clients). Pasting small excerpt: ```
{
  "token_count": 312,
  "billed_tokens": 320,
  "model_family": "redwood-2-xl",
  "decode_latency_ms": 12.4,
  "routing_latency_ms": 3.1,
  "ingest_ts": "2025-11-02T18:22:00Z"
}
```

Priya: Nice. For the ~0.6% missing model_family i can add a fallback mapping in the transform (map legacy model_id -> family). Will PR that after Sam's change.

Kevin: Noted. Sam, once your PR merges, can you kick another quick ingest to confirm `decode_latency_ms` present? Then we'll mark the canary-ready checklist item as done.

Sam: Will do. CR updates posted, requesting @Priya review. After merge i'll trigger a follow-up ingest.

Ashley: Great — owners: glossary = Priya, smoke ingest + sample validation = Jon, cost mapping doc = Kevin, ingestion change + follow-up smoke = Sam. ETA summary: glossary by 14:00 PT, initial smoke done (Jon), PR review in progress, final smoke after PR merge within ~1h. Please update the tracker and add runbook link. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-attrib.

Priya: Updated tracker and added the glossary stub. Leaving a note about fallback for legacy model ids.

telemetry-bot: canary-checklist updated: token-attrib step -> in-progress (owners assigned).

Jon: Follow-up smoke done after PR merge — sample count 4,510, `model_family` present in 99.99% after fallback. No schema errors in validation. P50 decode latency: 10.8ms, p95: 28.6ms.

Kevin: Excellent. I'm going to schedule the billing mapping rollout for tomorrow morning (small TTL). Will send the roll window in the channel.

Ashley: Thanks everyone. If no blockers by EOD i'll flip the canary flag tomorrow AM. :rocket:
